name: Milking Farm
source:
A farm run by succubi --
those held there are confined like livestock and milked of their cum.
To dissuade escape attempts, the succubi employ traps and illusions...
and sometimes a gangbang or two to tire the offender out too much to try again.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ273000.html/?locale=en_US]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一座由魅魔经营的农场——
被关在这里的人，如同牲畜般遭到囚禁，不断被榨取精液。
为了阻止逃跑，魅魔们设置陷阱，施展幻术……
有时，还会来上一两场轮奸，让试图逃走的人精疲力竭，再也无力尝试。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ273000.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
